facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at PSV-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-7103 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 26 March 2023 a corrective action on PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
